cqrs-app.label: map conflict
cqrs-app.filter: preserves the published map when a discovered handler conflicts with explicit registration

cqrs-app.label: discovery reentry isolation
cqrs-app.filter: rejects reentrant discovery without corrupting the active scan

cqrs-app.label: reject blank map path
cqrs-app.filter: rejects an invalid configured map path before discovery or artifact publication

cqrs-policy.label: strict command policy bypass
cqrs-policy.filter: never bypasses denied command policies for non-boolean or false skip flags

cqrs-policy.label: strict query policy bypass
cqrs-policy.filter: never bypasses denied query policies for non-boolean or false skip flags

cqrs-policy.label: reauthorize the enqueued command
cqrs-policy.filter: reauthorizes an enqueued command against the current actor and never executes it after access is revoked

cqrs-policy.label: reject unknown actor-aware wire fields before repository access
cqrs-policy.filter: rejects unknown actor-aware command fields without consulting the actor repository

cqrs-retry.label: retry eligibility
cqrs-retry.filter: propagates the original failure without retrying when metadata or eligibility excludes retry

cqrs-retry.label: configured exception matching
cqrs-retry.filter: propagates the original failure without retrying when metadata or eligibility excludes retry

cqrs-retry.label: minimum retry attempts
cqrs-retry.filter: rejects invalid retry attempt and delay configuration

cqrs-retry.label: default retry sleep units
cqrs-retry.filter: converts the configured default retry wait from milliseconds into microseconds

cqrs-lock.label: release real resource lock
cqrs-lock.filter: holds the real lock throughout nested execution and releases it on success or failure

cqrs-lock.label: nonzero lock lifetime
cqrs-lock.filter: rejects non-positive or non-finite lock lifetimes

cqrs-lock.label: nested main-context lock depth cleanup
cqrs-lock.filter: retains independent resource ownership through three nested dispatches in the same execution context

cqrs-lock.label: nested fiber lock depth cleanup
cqrs-lock.filter: retains independent resource ownership through three nested dispatches in the same execution context

cqrs-transaction-cycle.label: commit before returning
cqrs-transaction-cycle.filter: returns the downstream operation only after committing the transaction

cqrs-transport.label: trusted worker attribute snapshot
cqrs-transport.filter: re-dispatches transported commands with restored operation context and worker attributes

cqrs-transport.label: delivery logging
cqrs-transport.filter: does not alter delivery disposition when a logger throws

cqrs-transport.label: worker stop before idle sleep
cqrs-transport.filter: stops an idle polling loop without sleeping after a stop request during polling

cqrs-transport.label: both composite serializer contracts
cqrs-transport.filter: requires each of the two serializer contracts rather than accepting either one alone

cqrs-transport.label: reject mismatched deserialized command type
cqrs-transport.filter: rejects an envelope when a custom deserializer returns the wrong command type

cqrs-transport.label: reject invalid custom operation context before dispatch
cqrs-transport.filter: rejects invalid or reserved attributes returned by a custom context serializer

cqrs-transport.label: validate incoming non-finite context numbers
cqrs-transport.filter: rejects non-finite decoded values even when their attributes are allowlisted

cqrs-transport-console.label: fractional monotonic runtime regression
cqrs-transport-console.filter: does not expire a one-second runtime limit at an earlier integer-second boundary

cqrs-transport-console.label: console stop before idle sleep
cqrs-transport-console.filter: honors a stop signal received during an empty poll without another idle wait

cqrs-transport-console.label: reject blank console transport name
cqrs-transport-console.filter: rejects a blank transport name before resolving the registry

cqrs-transport-cycle.label: dead-letter rejection rollback
cqrs-transport-cycle.filter: rolls back the rejection tombstone when the dead-letter insert fails and keeps the receipt usable

cqrs-transport-cycle.label: strict database clock validation
cqrs-transport-cycle.filter: rejects malformed or relative database timestamps before persisting or changing delivery state

cqrs-transport-cycle.label: bounded queue claim attempts
cqrs-transport-cycle.filter: stops after the documented bounded claim attempts and can poll the pending message again
